limitations_and_boundaries: The review summarizes existing literature; no new experiments are performed.
Many studies cited are from in vitro or animal models; clinical relevance in humans remains to be fully established.
The role of TAZ in intravasation is unknown.
Whether YAP/TAZ target genes influence endothelial junction loosening during intravasation has not been directly investigated.
It is unclear whether all described Src effector pathways that regulate YAP/TAZ activity can do so in cancer.
More work is needed to determine how prevalent Src-mediated YAP/TAZ activation is in specific cancer types.
The potential adverse side effects of systemic YAP/TAZ inhibition in humans are not yet known.
